evidence.excerpt: Training general-purpose humanoids will need unprecedented compute capacity, and Figure is stacking the chips. Figure, with cloud partner Nscale, is deploying up to 100,000 NVIDIA Vera Rubin GPUs. It's committing $3.5 billion initially, with plans to scale to $6+ billion.
